name: Set Size Product Disguise
description: Replaces the pairwise inequality product formula with a condition on the product of the cardinalities of the sets of chosen parameters ($|S_1| \times |S_2| \times |S_3| = k^3$). Because exactly $k$ items are chosen, the maximum size of each set is $k$, so this forces all chosen parameters in each dimension to be distinct. This avoids explicit pairwise distinctness vocabulary and prevents pattern-matching to 3-Dimensional Matching or exact cover.
